shared.zh: 主语：句子说的是谁、是什么。标出它的名词短语：修饰成分都折起来以后，剩下的那几个词。
shared.en: subject: Who or what the sentence is about. Mark its noun phrase: the words left once its modifiers are folded.

shared.zh: 谓语：主语做什么、怎么样：整个动词词组，连同助动词（has been shown）。
shared.en: verb: What the subject does or is: the whole verb group, auxiliaries included (has been shown).

shared.zh: 宾语：动作落到的东西，跟在谓语后面的名词短语。
shared.en: object: What the action lands on: the noun phrase after the verb.

shared.zh: 表语：跟在 be 这类系动词后面、说明主语是什么或怎么样的成分。
shared.en: complement: What follows a linking verb such as be, saying what the subject is or what it is like.

shared.zh: 介词短语：介词开头的一串词（of the model、on a single GPU），整块修饰一个词。折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
shared.en: prepositional phrase: A preposition and what follows it (of the model, on a single GPU), modifying one word as a whole. Fold it and hang it on that word.

shared.zh: 定语从句：跟在名词后面、自带主语和谓语的小句（that we propose、which has seven billion parameters）。折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
shared.en: relative clause: A clause of its own, with its own subject and verb, after a noun (that we propose, which has seven billion parameters). Fold it and hang it on the word it modifies.

shared.zh: 读者：标出主干，把修饰成分折到它修饰的词上
shared.en: the reader: marks the skeleton, folds each modifier onto the word it modifies

shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up able to do, not how many levels

about.zh: 几个元件合起来是一个新概念
about.en: parts that are one new idea together

about.zh: 这一关带来的成分或结构
about.en: the roles and constructions the level brings in

shared.zh: 新东西第一次出现时只用它一个也算一关：它的用法抽象在哪里
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only uses it: what is abstract about its use

shared.zh: 句子里的一段词，出现不止一次时写 #n（change#2）
shared.en: words as they stand in the sentence, #n for the n-th of several (change#2)

about.en: the construction it is folded as

shared.zh: 挂在别的词（键）上时，那样挂是什么意思
shared.en: what hanging it on another word (the key) would mean

shared.zh: 标成这个成分、还立着的那几个词（小写）标错时说什么；* 是这句话根本没有这个成分
shared.en: what to say when these standing words (lower case) are marked as it; * when the sentence has no such role

shared.zh: 已经折好、拆不开的块（答案里的折）
shared.en: folds already made and fixed in place (folds of the answer)

shared.zh: 任务的 id：整款游戏里唯一，玩家存下的板跟着它走（只有一个任务的关通常就用关的 id）
shared.en: the task’s id, unique in the game; what a player keeps of it goes by it (a level’s one task usually has the level’s id)

shared.zh: 几句话依次做，最后一句就是这一关
shared.en: several sentences done in turn, the last one the level itself
